one_line: Maghrebi traveler and jurist visiting the bustling port of Calicut on the Malabar coast in the 1340s.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, average height
appearance.face: oval face with warm olive-brown complexion, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, sharp thoughtful eyes with slightly heavy lids, straight nose, gently arched brows, default expression calm and observant with a faint curious smile
appearance.hair: dark brown-black hair, kept short and tidy under a soft white cotton turban wrapped in a simple Maghrebi style with a narrow tail tucked at the back, no ornaments on the turban
appearance.costume: A long, ankle-length, straight-cut light-cream cotton tunic (qamis) with narrow sleeves and a simple round neckline, worn under a sleeveless deep-indigo woolen over-robe (jubba) that opens at the front and is belted with a brown leather girdle; loose sand-beige cotton trousers gather at the ankles above plain dark brown leather slippers; over his left shoulder runs a narrow rust-red cotton travel sash, slightly worn at the edges, and he carries a small weathered leather satchel at his hip; fabrics are plain, with only subtle woven borders in darker indigo along the robe’s hem and armholes.
appearance.signature: A well-used rolled parchment travel map tied with a thin leather thong, held in his left hand or tucked under his arm as his constant prop, symbolizing his journeys and observations.

ref_desc: Ibn Battuta is a mid-30s olive-brown Maghrebi traveler with a short beard, white turban, cream tunic, deep-indigo sleeveless robe, sand-beige trousers, brown slippers, rust-red sash, and a rolled parchment travel map in hand, using a cream and indigo-dominated palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Ibn Battuta in Calicut: a mid-30s olive-brown Maghrebi traveler with an oval thoughtful face, neatly trimmed beard and moustache, sharp observant eyes, and short dark hair under a simple white cotton turban. He wears a long ankle-length light-cream cotton tunic with narrow sleeves, over which is a sleeveless deep-indigo woolen robe that opens at the front, cinched with a brown leather belt. Loose sand-beige cotton trousers gather above plain dark brown leather slippers, and a narrow rust-red cotton sash crosses from his right shoulder to his left hip, slightly worn. A small weathered leather satchel hangs at his side. In his left hand he holds a rolled parchment travel map tied with a thin leather thong, his constant prop. Show him in neutral standing and slight turn poses to display the face, turban, layers of cream tunic and indigo robe, trousers, slippers, sash, satchel, and the parchment map clearly, with the palette dominated by cream, deep indigo, sand beige, rust red, and dark brown.
